assertionCoverage.name: S6/029: policy rows are immutable and versioned
assertionCoverage.clause: The Lite v1 persisted policy records the 120 second compaction timeout.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The repository test reads the actual policy row used by compaction and directly asserts its timeout value.

assertionCoverage.name: S6/029: policy rows are immutable and versioned
assertionCoverage.clause: The Lite v1 persisted policy allows one automatic retry.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The repository test reads the actual immutable policy record and directly asserts the retry bound.

assertionCoverage.name: S6/029: a reclaimed lease cannot publish from the old holder or version
assertionCoverage.clause: Reclaiming an expired lease advances the durable task out of running.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The repository test invokes the real lease-reclaim transaction and asserts the resulting persisted state before attempting stale publication.

assertionCoverage.name: S6/029: a reclaimed lease cannot publish from the old holder or version
assertionCoverage.clause: A holder using the old running version cannot publish after lease reclamation.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The named repository test attempts publication with the old holder and pre-reclaim version and requires the production repository's COMPACTION_CONFLICT assertion.

assertionCoverage.name: S6/029: a reclaimed lease cannot publish from the old holder or version
assertionCoverage.clause: Rejected stale publication leaves the reclaimed task retry-pending.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The test reads the canonical compaction row after the stale publish attempt and verifies the durable state did not regress to published.

assertionCoverage.name: S6/029: a reclaimed lease cannot publish from the old holder or version
assertionCoverage.clause: A rejected stale publisher cannot write a summary.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The repository test directly observes the summary column after the rejected stale publication and confirms no stale result was persisted.

assertionCoverage.name: S6/029: one running compaction per Conversation and bounded retry/failure branches
assertionCoverage.clause: A second running compaction for one Conversation is rejected by the durable uniqueness fence.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The repository test creates a second task for the same Conversation and directly asserts the production claim transaction rejects the competing holder.

assertionCoverage.name: S6/029: one running compaction per Conversation and bounded retry/failure branches
assertionCoverage.clause: The durable retry transition increments the attempt number exactly once.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The repository test reclaims the first running task, claims its retry, and reads the persisted attempt count.

assertionCoverage.name: S6/029: one running compaction per Conversation and bounded retry/failure branches
assertionCoverage.clause: The durable task records retry exhaustion as a terminal failure.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The repository test performs the terminal failure transition after the second attempt and directly reads the canonical failure code.
